Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready printable fantasy RPG page border, not a mockup. Create one exceptionally polished ornamental A4 portrait page background, height/width about 1.414, high resolution. IRONBOUND: forged dark steel and silver edge plates, rivets, interlocking chainmail, weathered crimson cloth, crossed longswords and a closed knight's helm. Top corners show detailed pauldrons and red pennants. Bottom corners carry a small armored gauntlet and a raven beside a broken spear. Mature heroic martial fantasy, silver charcoal vermilion.
Style: hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic, expressive variable-width brush contours, flat opaque vivid natural colors, two or three hard-edged chromatic shadow shapes, sparse dry-brush material texture, crisp crafted illustration; no vector UI, no photorealism, no glossy 3D, no airbrush blending. A premium illustrated roleplaying game folio.
Composition is crucial: the full page lies flat and front-on. All illustrations live in an outer border. Keep the enormous central rectangular writing area from x=8% to 92%, y=13% to 94% PURE WHITE and entirely empty. The left and right decorative border each occupies ONLY the outer 6% of page width, delicate but richly illustrated. Top decoration occupies the first 11% of page height, with more substantial illustrated corners and a continuous ornamental top edge. Keep the middle of the header (x=22% to 78%, y=3% to 11%) PURE WHITE and empty for a typeset title. Bottom border occupies the bottom 5%. Show the full border inside the image with a narrow 2% pure white outside margin, nothing cropped. Every central writing surface is plain clean white without paper stains. NOT a full background scene.
No letters, no words, no numbers, no runes resembling lettering, no logo, no watermark. No content grid, no stat boxes, no portrait inside. Only the rich illustrated page surround and empty white paper. Deliberately designed, graceful, expensive-looking book illustration.

Make a square high-resolution image containing exactly FOUR separate empty ornamental portrait frames, in a perfectly regular 2 x 2 grid. Each frame centered in its quadrant with a clear 5% white gutter around it. No overlap between quadrants. All frames face forward and are square, not oblique. Keep their large square inner opening PURE WHITE and empty, at least 72% of each frame's width and height. No people or portraits.
Top left: IRONBOUND frame, forged steel, tiny rivets, layered chainmail corners, crimson cloth tied around one corner, small swords and a dark helmet crest.
Top right: WAYFARER frame, beautifully carved wood with gnarled ivy/oak leaves, teal leather ties, an owl feather, miniature compass.
Bottom left: STARWEAVER frame, exquisite silver astronomical filigree, violet crystal corners, cobalt enamel, tiny crescent moon crest.
Bottom right: CHRONICLE frame, illuminated manuscript scrollwork, warm brass, ivory parchment, cobalt and vermilion accents, a quill and a wax seal.
Style: hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic, rich crafted material illustration, expressive variable-width brush contours, flat opaque vivid natural colors with two or three hard-edged chromatic shadow shapes, sparse dry-brush texture, elegant believable details. Mature premium fantasy book design. No vector outline placeholders. No glossy 3D. Avoid photographs. Background is plain white. No checkerboard, no shadows outside the objects, no letters, numbers, labels, watermark, or writing. Highly presentable matching art kit.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready illustrated fantasy RPG resource counters, to be printed as functional writing spaces. Create a very wide landscape high-resolution sprite atlas, four equally sized isolated objects in one perfectly aligned horizontal row, each in its own quarter of the canvas, generous white gutters between objects. Plain white background, no outside shadows, no text anywhere.
Left to right, EXACTLY four objects:
1. A broad heart-shaped red enamel and antique gold reliquary frame. Its large heart-shaped central opening is PURE WHITE and blank, with the rich ruby material only around the edge.
2. A broad amethyst crystal and silver magical vessel frame, faceted glowing violet crystals clustered around an octagonal opening. The large central area is PURE WHITE and blank, no facet lines through the opening.
3. A front-facing beautifully illustrated steel breastplate with articulated shoulder armour, straps and tiny brass rivets. A very large central chest plate, at least 55% of the object width and 45% of its height, is PURE WHITE and blank for a number. Do not draw any detail across this chest space. The armour must look like armour, not a t-shirt symbol.
4. A heroic round medallion with a five-point gold star subtly worked into its rim, vermilion ribbon ends and small laurel leaves. The large central circular disc is PURE WHITE and completely blank for a number.
All four objects have broad empty central spaces to contain handwritten stats, illustrated material-rich frames of similar apparent weight, and exactly matched overall scale. Not thin vector outlines or flat UI boxes.
Style: premium hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic, decisive variable-width brush-ink contours, mature believable equipment, vivid disciplined natural colors, flat opaque fills, two or three hard-edged shadows, sparse handmade dry-brush texture. Golden accents tie the four together. Clean crisp print illustration. No photorealism, no 3D, no painterly blending, no text, no numerals, no labels, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium fantasy book page decoration atlas. Square high resolution image, exactly FOUR isolated functional blank writing frames in a precise regular 2 x 2 grid, each asset centred within its own quadrant and separated by broad pure white gutters. Same rich hand-inked material style across all four.
Top left: a small square ivory cartouche with a narrow antique brass rim, lightly engraved corner clamps and two small dark steel rivets, HUGE clean pure white blank centre, at least 80% of the square.
Top right: a wide horizontal parchment ribbon, its face PURE WHITE and entirely blank, rolled slightly at both ends, warm brown ink contours with gold details. A restrained feather-and-leaf flourish sits at one end only. Width about three times height.
Bottom left: a large rectangular blank manuscript panel, very slim beautifully irregular parchment edges, tiny bronze corner ornaments and a subtle folded corner; the entire inside must be PURE WHITE and empty. No dots, no texture or stains within the writing area, no page ruling.
Bottom right: an exceptionally graceful thin horizontal divider of crossed antique quills, oak leaves and brass scrollwork, delicate ink lines sweeping to each side. It should frame blank white space rather than become a solid bar. Width about three times height.
Style: hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic illustration, expressive variable-weight brush contours, flat opaque colors, two or three hard-edged shadows, sparse dry-brush material detail. Warm ivory, antique brass, dark sepia line work, small restrained teal and red highlights. NOT vector UI, not simple rectangles, not photoreal, not 3D. No lettering, numbers, faux writing, logo or watermark. Each of the four assets is complete and does not touch another quadrant. Pure white background.
